title: Made an AI assisted backed tabletop enemy website, thinking of expanding to use AI to generate 3d assets from 2d tokens
author: Barthim
selftext:
I made a dnd / tabletop rpg website with AI assistance while I was learning about 2d -> 3d AI workflows, was a fun project I'm trying to learn more about how to go from 2d to 3d assets.   
  
My workflow for this was using local LLMs for iteration on tabletop concepts, I'll usually have an idea in mind then work to come up with prompts to solidify the idea, then built it into a group of enemies, then use AI image engines to come up with the art. Then I built a website assisted by AI coding tools (codex) that can pack things together, and serve as a storefront.  
  
  
Not sure how to share about it since people seem to hate AI
